questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{依题设可得} \\ & \quad E(\overline{X})=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}E(X_{i})=\frac{1}{n}\times nE(X)=E(X), \\ & \quad E(Y)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}E(X_{i})=E(X)\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}=E(X). \\ & \text{从而}\ \overline{X},\ Y \text{均为}E(X)\text{的无偏估计量，由于} \\ & \quad D(\overline{X})=\frac{1}{n^{2}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}D(X_{i})=\frac{1}{n}D(X), \\ & \quad D(Y)=D\bigg(\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}X_{i}\bigg)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}^{2}D(X_{i})=D(X)\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}^{2}, \\ & \text{应用柯西--施瓦茨不等式可知} \\ & \quad 1=\bigg(\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}\bigg)^{2}\leq\bigg(\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}^{2}\bigg)\bigg(\sum_{i=1}^{n}1^{2}\bigg)=n\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}^{2},\ \frac{1}{n}\leq\sum_{i=1}^{n}C_{i}^{2}, \\ & \text{所以}D(Y)\geq D(\overline{X}),\ \text{故}\ \overline{X}\text{比}Y\text{有效}.\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}(1)\ \ E\bigg(c\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}(X_{i+1}-X_i)^2\bigg)&=c\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}E(X_{i+1}^2-2X_iX_{i+1}+X_i^2)\\&=c\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}\{D(X_{i+1})+[E(X_{i+1})]^2-2E(X_i)E(X_{i+1})+D(X_i)+[E(X_i)]^2\}\\&=c(n-1)(\sigma^2+\mu^2-2\mu^2+\sigma^2+\mu^2)=2(n-1)c\sigma^2. \end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}\text{令}2(n-1)c\sigma^2=\sigma^2\ \ ,\ \text{所以}c=\frac{1}{2(n-1)}.\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}(2)\ \ E[(\overline{X})^2-cS^2]=E(\overline{X})-cE(S^2)=D(\overline{X})+[E(\overline{X})]^2-c\sigma^2=\frac{\sigma^2}{n}+\mu^2-c\sigma^2.\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}\text{令}\ \frac{\sigma^2}{n}+\mu^2-c\sigma^2=\mu^2\ ,\ \text{得}c=\frac{1}{n}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{因为总体}X\sim b(n,p),\ \text{所以}\ \ \\&\quad\quad\quad E(X) = np,\\&\quad\quad\quad E(X^2) = D(X) + [E(X)]^2 = np(1-p) + n^2p^2 = np - np^2 + n^2p^2,\\&\text{而}\ E\left(\sum_{i=1}^n X_i^2\right) = nE(X^2) = n^2p - n^2p^2 + n^3p^2,\ \ E\left(\sum_{i=1}^n X_i\right) = nE(X) = n^2p\,,\\&\text{所以}\ E\left[\sum_{i=1}^n (X_i^2 - X_i)\right] = (n-1)n^2p^2.\ \text{故}\ \frac{1}{n^2(n-1)}\sum_{i=1}^n (X_i^2 - X_i)\text{是}p^2\text{的无偏估计量}.\end{aligned}
